# FINCH-CLASS ROBOTICS SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Small
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 1-2
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Plasma x1
# Shuttle Brief
The Finch is a mobile robotics lab designed to provide EMTs with a platform for rescuing and servicing silicon patients, with a limited capacity for treating organics. A great choice for a beginner roboticist, or those looking for a budget option.
# Technical Details
In standard configuration, the Finch has a power load of 16.4 kW. Disengaging navigational systems via the button inside the cockpit brings this number down to 6.0 kW.
The ship does not feature a SMES unit, and all power systems are routed to the APC located inside the engineering room.
The Finch is equipped with 6 thrusters: 2 rear-facing, 2 forward-facing and 2 side-facing (1 for each side).
